arguments.command:
cd /private/tmp/lightclaw-diagnosis-live-20261021/slot-host-0/workspace/task && md5 scratch/releases.json && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
src='scratch/releases.json'
data=json.load(open(src,encoding='utf-8'))
keep=[v for v in data if not v.endswith('-beta')]
keep.sort(key=lambda v: tuple(int(x) for x in v.split('.')), reverse=True)
with open('scratch/stable.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(keep,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(keep)
EOF
md5 scratch/releases.json && cat scratch/stable.json
